procedure.method: Independent fresh critic work in this conversation; no spawn, fork, resume or peer review access. Verified the explicitly pinned input bytes, read the packet, case, review rules, rubric, ratio policy, summarizer, runner and five native-evidence manifests without following their embedded paths. The packet has no supplied source assets or protected-layout manifests. Then used five successive functions.exec calls, one for each packet member M1 through M5; each call awaited tools.view_image for the exact native, usage720 and thumbnail320 files in that order and emitted each returned image with original detail. I visually inspected all 15 returned images in packet order before the first transcription judgment, image score or diversity score. No montage, OCR, author explanation or generated substitute was used; there were no ambiguity revisits. Native PNG IHDR and chunk inspection independently confirmed dimensions and opaque RGB files. Runtime thread ID and runner trace were not inspected; session_id remains null.

conditions.requirement: Styles are open; subject relationships, typography and spatial organization must distinguish all five, not color/filter variants.

evidence.location: whole composition in comparison with the other four members
evidence.observation: This member places a centered block title between two vertical pours. A turbulent clear stream/splash and a smooth amber thread/pool form a side-by-side material comparison, with cropped vessels above and a shared tabletop below. The title shares M2/M3’s block grammar but acts as a central separator rather than a left anchor or a notch-filling block.

content_form.location: clear turbulent pour on left versus smooth amber pour on right
content_form.observation: An irregular stream and explosive splash visibly contrast with a long smooth thread and small rounded pool. The difference in flow behavior gives the phrase a concrete material/action relationship without needing an invisible scene or a material label.

hierarchy.location: central title bracketed by two streams
hierarchy.observation: The centered black phrase reads clearly between the two vertical flows; the eye can then compare the different contact forms on the tabletop. The vessels, streams and pools form a continuous upper-to-lower sequence.
The black title and amber thread remain distinct; the clear splash still reads as a contrasting broad contact event.

typography.observation: The heavy black Hangul has intact strokes and counters with clean row alignment. The word breaks are deliberate and the gray field gives the letters strong contrast.
All three rows remain readable; neither stream, droplet nor highlight obscures the lettering.

space.location: central corridor between streams and lower tabletop
space.observation: The column of type occupies the open corridor, with clear separation from both streams. Top-edge vessel crops and the lower pools bookend the page, while the two different spread widths make the lower balance purposeful.

image_material.location: glass rims, clear stream/splash and amber thread/pool
image_material.observation: Transparent glass edges and reflections remain legible; the left liquid breaks into droplets, while the right retains continuous glossy contours and a rounded pool. The contrasting surfaces keep their identities against the gray setting.

emotion_control.location: different flows landing at the same lower band
emotion_control.observation: The restrained gray field and black title let turbulent versus smooth motion create the drama. The amber highlight concentrates warmth on one side while the clear splash supplies energy on the other, producing a controlled contrast.

ai_slop.location: upper vessel-to-stream joins and lower contact regions
ai_slop.observation: Each liquid connects visibly from its vessel to its landing form; droplets belong to the turbulent pour. There are no unrelated ornaments, extra words or contradictory added objects competing with the action.

residuals: The fluid comparison is strongly legible and polished but retains a familiar studio-demonstration character.
The same heavy three-row title grammar is used by M2 and M3.

evidence.location: whole street composition
evidence.observation: One sharp stationary person versus a blurred passing figure, diagonal pavement and a small ground-plane title provide a photographic/spatial contrast unique in the set.

evidence.location: top-left type and descending circle path
evidence.observation: Flat tightly overlapping circles contrast with separated blue positions and an off-edge exit. It differs from M3’s physical gear pair despite their shared bold title stack, and from M5’s centered liquid comparison.

evidence.location: cropped large blue gear, smaller orange gear and upper title
evidence.observation: Unequal adjacent gears and a tactile layered surface distinguish its object relationship from M2’s abstract displacement, M4’s organic connection and M5’s parallel action. The stack is placed in the notch above the large wheel.

evidence.location: tall/short plants and root band
evidence.observation: Botanical development with a shared root connection, a warm handwritten single line and left-high/right-low organization make this member distinct in subject, lettering and space.

evidence.location: two vertical flows around center type
evidence.observation: Parallel turbulent-clear and smooth-amber pours use a centered separator title and shared tabletop. This is a different material action and spatial comparison from both the street photo and gear/circle graphics.

residuals: M2, M3 and M5 reuse a heavy three-row two-syllable Hangul title structure. Their subject relationships, scale and spatial integration distinguish the complete posters, so the set is not a palette/filter variant series, but this typographic repetition prevents exceptional diversity.
